about: Synthetic documents written for this bench, modelled on the formats DPA teams handle. Every company, fund and person in them is fictional. No client data, ever.

tasks.title: Rent roll: occupancy and tenant concentration
tasks.why: Aggregating a real-estate rent roll: occupancy, tenant count and concentration need sums across rows.
tasks.instruction: From this rent roll: occupancy_pct = leased square feet / total square feet, as a percentage with one decimal. tenant_count = number of distinct tenants (not units; vacant is not a tenant). largest_tenant = the tenant with the most annual base rent across all its units; largest_tenant_rent_share_pct = its share of total annual base rent, one decimal. earliest_expiry = the earliest lease expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tasks.title: Credit memo: leverage, coverage and covenant headroom
tasks.why: Credit research arithmetic: net leverage, interest cover, covenant tests and how far EBITDA can fall.
tasks.instruction: From the credit memo (USD millions): net_debt = total debt minus cash. net_leverage = net debt / EBITDA (two decimals). interest_coverage = EBITDA / interest expense (two decimals). ebitda_margin_pct = EBITDA / revenue as a percentage. leverage_covenant_ok and coverage_covenant_ok = whether each covenant is met. ebitda_cushion_pct = how far EBITDA could fall, as a percentage, before net leverage breaches the covenant (net debt unchanged), one decimal.

tasks.title: Distribution waterfall: pref, catch-up and carry
tasks.why: The calculation behind every PE distribution notice: return of capital, preferred return, GP catch-up, then the split.
tasks.instruction: Run this European (whole-fund) distribution waterfall and give the amounts in USD millions. preferred_return = the LPs' total preferred return. gp_catch_up = the GP's catch-up amount. lp_total and gp_total = what each receives in total. gp_share_of_profit_pct = the GP's total as a percentage of total profit (distributions minus contributed capital).
tasks.document:
WATERFALL TERMS (Limited Partnership Agreement, Section 8.1)
1. Return of capital: 100% to the LPs until they have received their contributed capital.
2. Preferred return: 100% to the LPs until they have received 8% per year, simple (not compounded), on contributed
   capital, for the holding period.
3. GP catch-up: 100% to the GP until the GP has received 20% of all distributions made under steps 2 and 3.
4. Thereafter: 80% to the LPs and 20% to the GP.

FUND FACTS
Contributed capital: USD 120.0 million, all contributed at the start of the holding period.
Holding period: 4 years.
Total distributions available at exit: USD 180.0 million.
